definitions.configured_stream_day_completeness: Valid pollutant-day observations divided by expected configured pollutant-day observations.
definitions.unique_station_day: One distinct station/date pair with at least one valid pollutant daily mean.
definitions.who_context_pollutant_day_observation: A valid pollutant-day observation above the pollutant-specific WHO 2021 24-hour contextual reference; not a UK legal exceedance.

claim_boundary: descriptive observed concentrations and data completeness only
no individual exposure or health-risk determination
regional comparisons are shown only where the multi-station eligibility rule is met
completeness_scope: valid pollutant-day observations divided by expected pollutant-day observations for every currently configured NO2, PM10 and PM2.5 stream discovered at active English AURN sites

configured_stream_day_completeness_formu.formula: 100 × valid pollutant-day observations / expected configured pollutant-day observations

data_posture: provisional and ratified official AURN automatic measurements, status flags preserved

methodology.changing_panel_sensitivity: daily reporting station and region counts plus fixed-panel series
methodology.hour_ending_24_rule: 24:00 is retained as next-day 00:00 UTC but aggregated to the printed source calendar date
methodology.regional_aggregation: equal-weight median of valid station-daily means
methodology.time_basis: GMT hour ending; daily aggregation uses the printed source calendar date

period_end_rule: latest completed source-calendar day with valid evidence in all 9 English regions

software_provenance.workflow: AQ26 Daily and Weekly Scientific Observatory

station_discovery.method: official active-site selector plus per-site AURN metadata pages

time_basis_assurance.time_basis: GMT hour ending; daily aggregation uses the printed source calendar date

who_context_count_definition: Count of valid pollutant-day observations whose daily mean exceeded the pollutant-specific WHO 2021 24-hour contextual reference. This is not a UK legal exceedance count and is independent of station-period eligibility.
